text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for service router-service v2.3.1 -> blue pool (wave 1). Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary config: 10% for 10m then ramp. CI: green.
alex: copying notes here — warmup=120s, healthcheck=/health?ready, scale target=2 extra nodes for blue.
jamie: FYI saw a p95 spike on shadow tests earlier, prob cache cold-starts. recommend pin session affinity for first 5m.
marta: @jamie +1. Let's hold initial traffic at 10% and not exceed 33% until warm cache observed. Add rollback conditions: >3% 5xx for 5m OR p95 > 450ms for 10m.
sre-oncall: setting temporary cb: error_threshold=30%, alarm if >50 5xx/min. I'll also open an incident channel if thresholds breach.
alex: ok I'm kicking off blue pool creation, running: ```./infra/provision --env=eu-west1 --pool=blue --size=2```
deploy-bot: blue pool created, nodes added (2), readiness OK. Traffic hold at 10%.
deploy-bot: traffic shift: 10% -> blue.
jamie: seeing lat jump on 3 hosts: p95 180ms -> 320ms, concurrent cache fills. putting a short throttle on retries.
marta: tweak request timeout in router from 1.2s -> 3s for healthchecks while warmup completes.
alex: updated router config: `healthcheck.timeout=3s`, pinned version mapping: blue -> v2.3.1-beta, fallback -> v2.3.0.
deploy-bot: router config applied, confirm.
jamie: a few 502s (n=7) right after patch, looks transient and tied to the old backend draining. watching.
sre-oncall: alarm triggered at 02:10 for increased 502s, investigating.
alex: scaled blue by +1 to help handle fill, command: `kubectl scale --replicas=3 deploy/router-blue`
deploy-bot: scale confirmed. traffic remains 10%.
jamie: metrics trending better, 502s down to 1-2/min, p95 back to ~200ms. propose ramp to 33% over 3m.
marta: agreed. ramp plan: 10 -> 33 (%), hold 10m, check errors & p95. manual hold allowed.
sre-oncall: updating runbook: rollback criteria note: immediate rollback if sustained error_rate >5% for 5m OR p95 >500ms for 5m. Also add: manual abort allowed by @marta or @alex.
a lex: (typo fixed) ack. initiating ramp.
deploy-bot: traffic shift: 33% -> blue over 3m.
jamie: post-ramp brief spike in 502s (peak 12 in 2m) but then dropped to baseline. Looks like one backend had an OOM restart; restarted and drained.
sre-oncall: marked that instance as cordoned, rotated traffic off it.
marta: adding release note: "router-service v2.3.1-beta deployed to blue pool; initial ramp to 33%. Pinned version and healthcheck timeout extended during warmup. Rollback criteria documented." Also linking PR: https://git.redwood/repo/router/PR/4512
alex: leaving a sticky note in ops: ensure sessions pinned for 5m -> session-affinity: cookie, ttl=300s.
deploy-bot: traffic shift paused (manual hold requested by marta).
jamie: monitoring dashboards for next 15m, reporting p95 and 5xx in #sre-metrics.
marta: decision: hold at 33% for 15m, if no regressions, continue to 66% then final 100% in a separate window. If regressions, rollback to v2.3.0 and evacuate blue pool.
sre-oncall: alarms set, escalation path configured.
alex: added quick rollback command in the channel: ```deploy-bot rollback router-service --to v2.3.0 --force```
deploy-bot: acknowledged the rollback shortcut is available to on-call.
jamie: small note — we'll also warm caches proactively before next ramp: run phantom traffic for 2m across new nodes.
marta: good. scheduling phantom run after hold.
alex: thanks everyone, keep eyes on dashboards. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy progress: wave1 complete (33% steady). Pending manual continue for wave2. Logs: https://logs.redwood/streams/router/3472129876
